title: The Sem-Lex Benchmark: Modeling ASL Signs and Their Phonemes
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark measures the accuracy of recognizing American Sign Language (ASL) signs and their phonological components.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of the study.
